posts.t: Thanks Carousel. It's easy in hindsight to say "yes I would have entered" but I cannot say that. What's important is to study many of these formations and decide for yourself where possible entry points exist. QMs seem to provide a few entry opportunities such as decision points, new supply or demand, etc.

On one of your charts (Please press the insert button, BTW, I hate having to edit images in!) you brought up something important

QMs need not be to the pip. Keep in mind the rules of reading the marketat all times

If price initially turned before Supply or Demand, price can often break it, attracted to the true zone

posts.t:
Nope

You're thinking FTB - First time back

FTR is Failure To Return - it's where a level gets broken, and price tries to get back in but fails. This marks the edge of a PAZ

See Wolverine's and CapnP's journals for the Hook - It's well documented by them
posts.fa:
نه

داری به FTB فکر می‌کنی — اولین بازگشت

FTR یعنی عدم بازگشت — جایی است که یک سطح شکسته می‌شود و قیمت سعی می‌کند به آن برگردد ولی شکست می‌خورد. این لبهٔ یک PAZ را علامت می‌زند

ژورنال‌های Wolverine و CapnP را برای «الهوک» ببین — آن‌ها خوب مستندش کرده‌اند
